annotations.title: Analyze current transits (Gochara) against the natal chart

description: CURRENT TRANSITS (GOCHARA). For each graha at asOfIso: house from the natal Moon and Lagna, classical favourability, Vedha obstruction, its own Ashtakavarga bindus, Kakshya lord, Murthy Nirnaya for slow planets, plus Sade Sati/Dhaiya and Jupiter–Saturn double-transit houses. Use for 'how are my transits now / this month'.

asOfIso.description: ISO date-time to evaluate; defaults to now

place.description: Catalogue query or display label when explicit coordinates are supplied

time.description: Local birth time HH:MM (24-hour); 6:30 PM is also accepted

timezone.description: Required IANA timezone when explicit coordinates are supplied, for example Asia/Kolkata

timezoneOffset.description: Optional fallback offset; derived from timezone and the requested local date when omitted

name: analyze_transits
title: Analyze current transits (Gochara) against the natal chart
